name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NonLattice.kilian_mixed_telescope
title: Kilian randomization telescopes on every word, mixed inputs included: prod_j p_j^-1 M_j p_(j+1) = p_0^-1 (prod_j M_j) p_L
statement: In any group G, for p : Fin (L+1) -> G, step labels M : Fin L -> Bool -> G and any choice c : Fin L -> Bool (not necessarily consistent with one input), the ordered product of p_j^-1 M_j(c_j) p_(j+1) equals p_0^-1 times the ordered product of M_j(c_j) times p_L.
